purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.

registryAssessment: A Shandong Provincial Big Data Bureau publication names Tengzhou and describes Tengzhou municipal housing/real-estate systems that share data with its real-estate registration center, including digitized property-registration workflows and cadastral building survey data. This confirms a city-level registry function, but not parcel service coverage at the WUP point.
